items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Old Man Myers used to rent the rooms for a while.

ctx.x: But we were playing at the honeysuckle when you were in there weren't you? I think you were. Yeah we were playing. Because this is funny. This is a funny thing. There's a road there that comes down from one road. One house is here. Actually, Pontchartrain Boulevard. There was a Pan Am gas station in the corner. In about two blocks. It's actually Avenue A. I was in a house which is at one time the honeysuckle inn. This lady owned because I had a hospital bed.
Old Man Myers used to rent the rooms for a while.

So this was after it was redone. After it was all redone from the nightclub. And they used to have this road coming down there. And they had guys from the two bits club and from the honeysuckle inn. They had these lanterns. Lans. Kerosene lanterns. You know like a railroad lantern like that. You could swing it like that. And they're flagging you in for the white picture. And they're flagging you in. And they're flagging you in to come to their place. Well, if the honeysuckle inn was first and the band would…
